Description: LiPo cell 3.7 V 320 mAh (300 mAh min), 25.5 x 36 x 4.3 mm, protection PCM, 2 wires
Where it goes / notes: Behind the electrodes; cut off the plug, solder to J1 (red = pin 1). Check <= 4.4 mm thick and a PCM under the tape

Description: Qi receiver coil 30 x 29.6 x 0.9 mm, 8.23 uH
Where it goes / notes: Behind the battery, leads to L1. Also Mouser 810-WR303050-12F5-ID

Description: Piezo bender 20 mm, 6.3 kHz, wire leads
Where it goes / notes: Bonded (cyanoacrylate) inside the plug at PCB (19, 23.5), leads to BZ1

Description: Thermal gap pad 40 x 40 x 0.5 mm, 16.6 W/m-K
Where it goes / notes: Cut 10 x 7 mm pieces: TMP117 tab to the thermal window
Cut one spot, stick it inside the cup as the leak indicator

Description: O-ring 90 mm ID x 1.5 mm cross-section (93 mm OD), nitrile (NBR) 70 Shore A, pack of 5-10
Where it goes / notes: Plug groove. Must be exactly 1.5 mm cross-section: McMaster's 90 mm Viton rings (8683N269) are 2 mm and don't fit the groove. NBR is fine in bath water and with the silicone grease

Description: Screw, flat head, thread-forming for plastic, 18-8 stainless, Torx drive, M2 x 6 mm (pack of 50; 4 per device)
Where it goes / notes: Side walls into the plug, 4 per device. Fits the existing M2 holes (2.3 mm clearance, 1.6 mm pilot). The tip reaches 1.5 mm past the plug skirt, 0.9 mm clear of the coil: checked in fit_and_render.py

Description: Quick-recovery urethane foam (PORON-type), 1/16 in thick, 12 x 12 in, 18 psi (medium)
Where it goes / notes: Cut 30 mm discs: between the coil and the plug (1.6 mm free, 1.25 installed; swelling buffer)

Description: Suction cups 40 mm, clear PVC, mushroom head (pack of 12; leave the hooks off)
Where it goes / notes: Bracket keyholes, 2 per device (docs/enclosure.md 2.7). Bambu Lab HA011 is the same style if you ever order from Bambu
